title: [review] lichend.rs: Mutex unwrap will panic on poisoned lock
description: tx_queue.lock().unwrap() panics if the mutex is poisoned (a thread panicked while holding it). In an async daemon with multiple tasks, a panic in the sim_task could poison the mutex, crashing the entire daemon on the next push_tx_queue call. Use .lock().expect() with context or handle PoisonError gracefully.
close_reason: Fixed: Replaced .lock().unwrap() with .lock().unwrap_or_else(|poisoned| poisoned.into_inner()) in all 6 Mutex access sites to gracefully recover from poisoned locks instead of panicking
